response.rationale: Verdict CLEARS but with razor-thin headroom: shrunk dROAS 1.487 vs goal 1.45 (~2.5% buffer). A full +10% raise likely pushes marginal traffic against that thin margin. With tier B evidence and only 10 orders in 28 days, the dROAS estimate carries real sampling uncertainty, so a sub-goal outcome is plausible. Dampen the raise to ~60% (bid ≈ INR 371) to follow the CLEARS direction while preserving ROAS headroom; confidence moderate given the small order count.
